population.kidComparison: About 25.2 million people live in Mali—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Inland terrain bordered by neighboring countries.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Mali
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Mali.

exploration.didYouKnow: Mali is located in Western Africa and its capital city is Bamako.
